items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Pete was as happy as he could be... [INTERVIEWEE] Not that, what is he? Charlie Weaver, the comedian?

ctx.x: They made 45, Nelson told me that night. I don't know. That's what Nelson told me. I didn't know. I asked him for it. Who did he? Nelson did about right now. Oh yeah? 45. Can you beat that? They walked just one week. They walked one week. Can you beat that?

Pete was as happy as he could be. Yeah, they walked one week. And Charlie Weaver played Cornette with him, you know, the comedian. You didn't know, I didn't know that. He's on the Today Show or something. Is he? Yeah.
Not that, what is he? Charlie Weaver, the comedian?
